Methodological Notes

Transport mode parameters:

Walking: 5 km/h, no overhead time
Cycling: 16 km/h, 2+2 min walk (167m buffer)
Bus: 20 km/h, 5+10+5 min overhead (417m buffer)
Car: 35 km/h, 2+2 min walk (167m buffer)

Road network filters:
• Walking/Cycling: all road types (incl. living_street)
• Car: all road types (except living_street)
• Bus: primary roads only (primary, secondary, tertiary, trunk)

Layer types:
• Network: reachable road segments
• Area: network + final walk buffer

• Isochrones clipped to urban perimeter
• Data source: OSM (Base Map and Transport Network Infrastructure)
• Deep Learning Models: TabPFN (Land Values), DINOv2 (Land Cover)
